clarity.notes: Role-based IA is clear; demo logins and breadcrumbs orient evaluators quickly.

hierarchy.notes: Landing hero + dashboard stat grids establish primary vs secondary content; one primary CTA per key view.

typography.notes: Segoe/Inter stack, tight display tracking, uppercase labels with letter-spacing; mono for metrics.

motion.notes: Card hover, toast enter, skeleton shimmer; full Framer page transitions deferred to keep single-file stable.

brand.notes: Primary #2563EB, secondary slate, green only for verified/success; dark mode supported; no indigo/purple gradient slop.
